lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a cva variant s base class and its hover active sibling share a common substring e g bg cta and hover bg cta hover assert the base class as a standalone token split on whitespace or use a word boundary regex not via classname tocontain or a regression in the base class alone will not be caught
lessons.text: When a cva variant's base class and its hover/active sibling share a common substring (e.g. bg-cta and hover:bg-cta-hover), assert the base class as a standalone token (split on whitespace or use a word-boundary regex), not via className.toContain, or a regression in the base class alone will not be caught.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec requires pixel parity with a prototype s literal hardcoded tint colors while a must not simultaneously forbids raw hex fixed palette utilities in the same files resolve the tension explicitly in the spec e g approved formula or tolerance instead of leaving it for the implementer to invent a workaround
lessons.text: When a spec requires pixel-parity with a prototype's literal hardcoded tint colors while a must-not simultaneously forbids raw hex/fixed-palette utilities in the same files, resolve the tension explicitly in the spec (e.g. approved formula or tolerance) instead of leaving it for the implementer to invent a workaround.
evidence: spec.md P1 Primitivos AC5/AC7 (StepIcon/Badge) vs DS-MN-02 (design-tokens)

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec ac claims a composed screen works correctly under a given state e g dark mode require an rtl test on the composed screen itself not just on each primitive in isolation composition can hide interaction bugs that per primitive tests cannot see
lessons.text: When a spec AC claims a composed screen works correctly under a given state (e.g. dark mode), require an RTL test on the composed screen itself, not just on each primitive in isolation — composition can hide interaction bugs that per-primitive tests cannot see.
evidence: spec.md P1 Prova de paridade AC3 (login dark mode) (testing)

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a zod required field also gets a runtime cryptographic authorization check document two distinct failure outcomes validation for absent malformed forbidden for well formed but invalid instead of one generic error code in the spec s edge cases
lessons.text: When a Zod-required field also gets a runtime cryptographic/authorization check, document two distinct failure outcomes (VALIDATION for absent/malformed, FORBIDDEN for well-formed-but-invalid) instead of one generic error code in the spec's edge cases.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::a dark mode token parity ac is not proven by a static absence of raw palette guard alone pair it with an actual rendered or visual regression check or explicitly scope the ac down to no raw palette utilities in the spec
lessons.text: A dark-mode/token-parity AC is not proven by a static absence-of-raw-palette guard alone; pair it with an actual rendered or visual-regression check, or explicitly scope the AC down to 'no raw-palette utilities' in the spec.
evidence: ds-empresa-editar-parity.test.ts:28-34 (AC4, recurs identically at ds-empresa-cadastro-parity, ds-empresa-responsaveis-parity, ds-empresa-remover-parity) (companies,design-system)

lessons.key: gate_fail::int test dateoffset helpers using local date setdate flake near the 21 00 00 00 america sao paulo window because hojesaopaulo compares utc normalized calendar days against a db date column make date offset test helpers utc safe formatintimezone date utc not local wall clock arithmetic
lessons.text: Int-test dateOffset() helpers using local Date.setDate() flake near the 21:00-00:00 America/Sao_Paulo window because hojeSaoPaulo() compares UTC-normalized calendar days against a @db.Date column — make date-offset test helpers UTC-safe (formatInTimeZone/Date.UTC), not local wall-clock arithmetic.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a task s done when requires an e2e spec file and skill tdad only produced a test fixme skeleton under specs tests e2e the execute phase must promote it into the real e2e directory with live assertions before the task is marked done a skeleton left in specs is invisible to npm run test e2e in ci so gate build passing does not prove e2e coverage exists
lessons.text: When a task's Done-when requires an e2e spec file and skill-tdad only produced a test.fixme skeleton under .specs/.../tests/e2e/, the Execute phase must promote it into the real e2e/ directory with live assertions before the task is marked done — a skeleton left in .specs/ is invisible to npm run test:e2e in CI, so 'Gate: build' passing does not prove e2e coverage exists.
evidence: tasks.md T7/T8/T9 Done-when (e2e required, Gate: build) (jobs/e2e)
tasks.md T5 Done-when (badge e2e required, Gate: build) (jobs/e2e)

lessons.key: ac_gap::this repo has an established cheap pattern for testing a page level p 005 notfound guard mocked next navigation requireactiveperson prisma testing library render no playwright needed see empresa empresaid editar page test tsx any new app route with the same requireactiveperson personcompanygrant notfound shape should get an equivalent page test tsx do not defer the 404 assertion to e2e alone
lessons.text: This repo has an established cheap pattern for testing a page-level P-005 notFound() guard (mocked next/navigation + requireActivePerson + prisma, testing-library render, no Playwright needed, see empresa/[empresaId]/editar/page.test.tsx) — any new (app) route with the same requireActivePerson+personCompanyGrant+notFound shape should get an equivalent page.test.tsx; do not defer the 404 assertion to e2e alone.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec sets a p95 latency ac for a synchronous llm external call action add an explicit timing assertion or a documented deliberate decision to skip it instead of leaving it evidenced only by design intent max tokens caps sync framing
lessons.text: When a spec sets a p95 latency AC for a synchronous LLM/external-call action, add an explicit timing assertion (or a documented, deliberate decision to skip it) instead of leaving it evidenced only by design intent (max_tokens caps, sync framing).

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::concurrency race tests that fire two calls via promise all inside one node process can be masked by an app level ux pre check when run in a warmed up test suite assert on final db row count or bypass the pre check layer to prove the db constraint itself not just the end to end actionresult shape
lessons.text: Concurrency race tests that fire two calls via Promise.all inside one Node process can be masked by an app-level UX pre-check when run in a warmed-up test suite; assert on final DB row count or bypass the pre-check layer to prove the DB constraint itself, not just the end-to-end ActionResult shape.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::before proposing a new route prefix in design md check whether an existing route family for the same entity audience already exists and reuse it instead of opening a new namespace
lessons.text: Before proposing a new route prefix in design.md, check whether an existing route family for the same entity/audience already exists and reuse it instead of opening a new namespace.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::when a design specifies a domain guard s role parameter as the prisma role enum check the actual caller s session type first getcurrentperson currentperson roles is string so the guard signature should be readonly string to match not role
lessons.text: When a design specifies a domain guard's role parameter as the Prisma Role enum, check the actual caller's session type first — getCurrentPerson()/CurrentPerson.roles is string[], so the guard signature should be readonly string[] to match, not Role[].

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::guardas node fs de import proibido devem casar tanto from pkg quanto import pkg bare side effect sen o um mutante de import sem from sobrevive
lessons.text: Guardas node:fs de import proibido devem casar tanto 'from "pkg"' quanto 'import "pkg"' bare/side-effect, senão um mutante de import sem 'from' sobrevive.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::ao entregar seams de composi o classname actions items adicionar pelo menos um teste rtl que exercite o seam isoladamente n o s via composi o indireta de outro componente
lessons.text: Ao entregar seams de composição (className?, actions?, items?), adicionar pelo menos um teste RTL que exercite o seam isoladamente, não só via composição indireta de outro componente.
evidence: CASCA-15 (spec.md) — seam className?/actions? sem teste RTL de merge (src/app/(public)/_components/**)

lessons.key: ac_gap::next js middleware unit tests that build nextrequest directly with rsc protocol headers next router prefetch rsc baked in do not prove production behavior verify prefetch rsc signal detection in middleware ts against a real next start server curl real browser since these headers can fail to reach request headers in the live request pipeline even though unit tests pass
lessons.text: Next.js middleware unit tests that build NextRequest directly with RSC-protocol headers (next-router-prefetch, rsc) baked in do not prove production behavior — verify prefetch/RSC signal detection in middleware.ts against a real 'next start' server (curl + real browser), since these headers can fail to reach request.headers in the live request pipeline even though unit tests pass.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a rate limit security bypass keys off a single client controlled http header e g next js s next url adversarially test with a plain curl request forging just that header before accepting the fix an unauthenticated signal used to exempt traffic from a limiter is trivially exploitable unless corroborated with a second harder to forge signal or bounded by a non zero ceiling instead of a hard bypass
lessons.text: When a rate-limit/security bypass keys off a single client-controlled HTTP header (e.g. Next.js's Next-Url), adversarially test with a plain curl request forging just that header before accepting the fix — an unauthenticated signal used to exempt traffic from a limiter is trivially exploitable unless corroborated with a second, harder-to-forge signal or bounded by a non-zero ceiling instead of a hard bypass.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec s concurrency guarantee is framed as a pre existing db constraint acting as a backstop don t mark the ac fully verified without a dedicated concurrent write test flag it as a spec precision gap instead of silently trusting the index
lessons.text: When a spec's concurrency guarantee is framed as a pre-existing DB constraint acting as a backstop, don't mark the AC fully verified without a dedicated concurrent-write test — flag it as a spec-precision gap instead of silently trusting the index.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::a devdependency imported dynamically inside a function body can still be bundled into a webpack chunk and traced into most serverless function bundles by next js at build time verify with a grep over next nft json for the package name not just a green production build before calling a dependency out of the production path
lessons.text: A devDependency imported dynamically inside a function body can still be bundled into a webpack chunk and traced into most serverless-function bundles by Next.js at build time — verify with a grep over .next/**/*.nft.json for the package name, not just a green production build, before calling a dependency 'out of the production path'.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::an acceptance criterion describing a manual local end to end harness flow enqueue trigger observe in an external tool needs a live re drive as evidence during validation not an inference from unit tests covering only its component pieces
lessons.text: An acceptance criterion describing a manual/local end-to-end harness flow (enqueue + trigger + observe in an external tool) needs a live re-drive as evidence during validation, not an inference from unit tests covering only its component pieces.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when an ac requires omitting an empty optional ui element not just avoiding a placeholder string assert the element s absence from the dom directly e g by testid role not an indirect textcontent querybytext proxy that stays green even if the element renders empty
lessons.text: When an AC requires omitting an empty/optional UI element (not just avoiding a placeholder string), assert the element's absence from the DOM directly (e.g. by testid/role), not an indirect textContent/queryByText proxy that stays green even if the element renders empty.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::a client component that needs a pure io free export from a module whose barrel also re exports server only code next headers server actions must import that export directly from its source file not via the module barrel or the client bundle fails to build
lessons.text: A Client Component that needs a pure, IO-free export from a module whose barrel also re-exports server-only code (next/headers, Server Actions) must import that export directly from its source file, not via the module barrel, or the client bundle fails to build

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a disclosure component gates document level event listeners on an open visible state add a test that proves the listener is absent or its cleanup ran while closed not just that it works correctly while open
lessons.text: When a disclosure component gates document-level event listeners on an open/visible state, add a test that proves the listener is absent (or its cleanup ran) while closed, not just that it works correctly while open
